source_refs.locator: PDF physical p.62 (printed p.60), section 6, recent basin water deficits and climate impacts.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025 reports: 2022-23 deficits reached 81% in unnamed basins and cereal output fell 67%; the NDC records 50.4°C heat in Agadir and over 6,000 hectares burned in Oriental in 2023.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: PDF physical p.65 (printed p.63), section 7.2, flood deaths, displacement and service disruption.

evidence.compact_statement: The NDC reports historical flood deaths at Ourika in 1995 and Guelmim in 2014, and a separate national total of nearly 22,000 internal displacements in 2008-2024. That displacement total is not assigned to these cities or particular flood events.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: PDF physical pp.65-66 (printed pp.63-64), section 7.2, 2022 drought and agricultural losses.

evidence.compact_statement: The NDC reports drought-related fruit losses in Gharb, Haouz and Saïss in 2022 and disproportionate livelihood pressure on rural women. Its discussion links farm precarity with rural out-migration; it does not establish violence or allocate migration counts to these regions.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: PDF physical pp.37-38 (printed pp.35-36), territorial adaptation plans and regional actions.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2025 reports: Regional plans in Oriental, Drâa-Tafilalet, Souss-Massa, Béni Mellal-Khénifra and Marrakech-Safi target oasis and rural adaptation.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: PDF physical p.106 (printed p.98), Annex 4, adaptation projects and human mobility.

affected_groups: people at risk of climate-related migration
evidence.compact_statement: Morocco's NDC proposes wastewater reuse, groundwater management and interbasin transfers in 2026-2035 as measures intended to reduce water-stress migration. Benefits are not measured; interbasin transfer is not cross-border migration.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: PDF physical p.7, national climate circumstances and rainfall distribution.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2022-01 reports: The plan reports 1960-2018 rainfall decline, warming and increased aridity; southern and southeast Atlas provinces are arid, while Souss, El Haouz and Oriental include semi-arid zones.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: PDF physical p.10, fisheries vulnerability and exposure assessment.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2022-01 reports: By 2050, catch potential could fall 5% under RCP8.5; artisanal fishers, small aquaculture producers and women-majority fish processors are identified as especially exposed.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: PDF physical pp.61-63 and 69-74, oasis and community-based adaptation actions.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2022-01 reports: The plan proposes oasis livelihood diversification and climate early warning, and community-led vulnerability mapping and water options tailored to each mountain massif.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: PDF physical pp.32-33 (printed pp.25-26), Table 6.3 and discussion of labor and migration.

evidence.scenario: SC4: 25% water-supply reduction combined with crop-yield shocks; report describes medium- to long-run effects.
evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2020 reports: In modeled case SC4, a 25% water-supply reduction plus climate-related yield changes reduces national unskilled-labor demand by 7%; permanent losses may expand urban migration.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2020 reports: The 2020 report says the government program supports sprinkler and drip irrigation, targeting 555,000 hectares and a reduction in flood-irrigated land from 81% to 43%.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.
